title: Invariant Earth API
description: Invariant AI’s geospatial API for U.S. parcels, buildings, hazards and infrastructure. Each response includes the source and retrieval date where available.
lede: Get U.S. parcel, building, terrain, hazard and infrastructure data from Invariant AI. See the source and retrieval date for each result where available.

operations.title: Geocode a U.S. address
operations.description: Resolve a street address to coordinates. Check whether the result is a published address point or an estimate along the street before using it for a parcel lookup.

operations.title: Get fields for a coordinate
operations.description: Request field values for one U.S. point. Look up terrain, hazard exposure and mapped infrastructure. Each field has its own status and source.

operations.title: Get records for a parcel
operations.description: Find the containing parcel and request its records and parcel-level metrics. Check the parcel match status before you use the result.

operations.title: Measure drive times and access
operations.description: Compare distances and drive times, find nearby infrastructure, and screen sites against a travel-time limit. Estimate reachable population and labor force from Census tracts.

examplesDescription: See how the evidence was checked, then try the documented API workflow for your own site or portfolio.

examples.title: Check flood exposure before shortlisting
examples.description: See how two FEMA address checks compared with the mapped flood zone across a Clifton parcel.

workflow.label: Check a site’s FEMA flood zone

examples.title: Trace related mortgage filings
examples.description: See how an agreement and a rent assignment at 25 Water Street were linked by the recorder.

examples.description: Two Denver locations shared a coarse radar tile. The finer estimates showed different hail sizes.

setupPrompt: Help me connect Invariant Earth to this agent or project. Read https://docs.invariant-ai.com/mcp/installation and use the setup for my client. The MCP server is https://api.invariant-ai.com/mcp. Ask me to sign in or use my client’s secret storage for the API key. Then test the connection by looking up elevation at latitude 39.0438, longitude -77.4874 and show the source and retrieval time. For direct API integration, follow https://docs.invariant-ai.com/quickstart and read https://api.invariant-ai.com/v1/meta/fields for supported fields.
